fixes: Washi colour: face reads pink-salmon (#E8805A-ish) with a crumpled-foil mottle; lookbook 16 and 09 are cream-amber (#F2C77A) with a hot centre and darker edges. Lower saturation, add centre-to-edge vignette, soften fibre mottle. Mostly the washi_backlit tint library issue.

Lower box: the dark panel with a pale wooden door/louvre still looks like an unrelated cabinet at the base. Replace with a recessed 0.3 m dark kick panel with 4 corner iron straps as in lookbook 09, or fill with continuous glowing washi.
Posts: pale hinoki thin 0.04 m side posts. Lookbook 16 posts are dark and heavy, 0.12-0.15 m. Darken and thicken front posts to 0.08 m, add iron corner straps at 4 heights.
Cap: seed 1 flat boxed cap is good (bracket blocks landed); seed 2 hip cap reads as a tiny metal pyramid. Give it 0.10 m eaves with rafter ends to match seed 1.
Lattice: only a 3x3 grid in the bottom third now (landed), fine. Keep it and make the seed 3 box (1.4 m) use the same grid so it matches family.
LOD3 is a plain slab with 3 dark squares; add the crest triangle (it exists at LOD2) and the dark cap so it matches LOD2.
library_issues: washi_backlit has a pink/salmon tint instead of cream amber and a crumpled-foil texture.
summary: Large improvement: reads clearly as lookbook 16's lit tower with kanji, KAZAN-YU, crest, boxed cap, stone plinth and lattice skirt. LOD2/3 stay recognisable lit towers at 35/80 m. Only the washi colour (a library tint problem) holds material at 3, so it is one library fix away from pass.
